        "# Running the PulsePPG evaluation"

        "id": "uh2hILh_aUdT"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "#### Go to `/content/pulseppg/pulseppg/experiments/configs/PulsePPG_expconfigs.py` and comment out the non-WESAD eval configs line 39-58 as well as 69-118\n",

      }

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "#@title Inspect data\n",
        "\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import os\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "WESAD_BINARY_PATH = \"/content/pulseppg/pulseppg/data/datasets/wesad/binary\"\n",
        "print(os.listdir(WESAD_BINARY_PATH))\n",
        "\n",
        "# WESAD_4CLASS_DICT = {0: \"baseline\", 1: \"stress\", 2:\"amusement\", 3:\"meditation\"}\n",
        "WESAD_BINARY_DICT = {0: \"baseline\", 1: \"stress\"}\n",
        "\n",
        "test_X = np.load(os.path.join(WESAD_BINARY_PATH, 'test_X_ppg_50Hz.npy'))\n",
        "print(test_X.shape)\n",
        "test_y = np.load(os.path.join(WESAD_BINARY_PATH,'test_y_stress_50Hz.npy'))\n",
        "print(test_y.shape)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "cs0aaPwGDOXu"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "np.random.seed(10)\n",
        "rand_inds = np.random.choice(test_y.shape[0], 10)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "hOb2r1iIniIu"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "for i in rand_inds:\n",
        "  print(\"==============================================================================\")\n",
        "  print(f\"Index {i}\")\n",
        "  print(f\"True class: {test_y[i]} {WESAD_BINARY_DICT[int(test_y[i])]}\")\n",
        "  plt.title(f\"Sample PPG at 50Hz over 1 minute\")\n",
        "  plt.plot(test_X[i,0,:])\n",
        "  plt.show()\n",
        "  print(\"------------------------------------------------------------------------------\")\n",
        "  !{python_path} -u run_exp.py --config pulseppg --dontprint --test_idx={i}\n",
        "  print(\"------------------------------------------------------------------------------\")\n",
        "  print(f\"True class: {test_y[i]} {WESAD_BINARY_DICT[int(test_y[i])]}\")\n",
        "  print(\"==============================================================================\")"
